body:
Seat post for the `repo:www.objectos.ai` execution seat. Body is authoritative; title and assignee are derived views. Single writer: the sitting PM.

**开轮 R4 — `session_01FeA1nwBz1ohH65dvffUGKr` — 2026-09-02 ~07:05Z**, still open. **Usage wall 2026-09-02 ~10:00–11:20Z:** state flushed here before it, seat resumed 11:22Z; every wave-1 dev died at the wall, their pushed work was reviewed against GitHub, and two unfinished cards (#92, #132) were resumed in place rather than re-implemented.

## 0. Lane provenance

`www.objectos.ai` is the Astro marketing-and-blog site (`https://www.objectos.ai`); **not** `objectstack-ai/objectos` (docs, seat #9831). Opened 2026-08-25 on the maintainer's instruction (「把这 17 个 issue 建到 objectstack-ai/www.objectos.ai」「然后开始使用项目经理技能派发处理」). **Registered as a single-lane repo** since objectstack PR #12443 (decision objectstack#12227, closed 2026-08-26): this seat self-triages; 代裁 and cross-repo dedupe stay with the triage seat; no `domain:*` labels here.

## 1. Scope

- Astro. `content/blog/` (52 English posts + 5 how-tos awaiting their slots), `content/pages/{en,zh-Hans}/*.ts`, `content/glossary/{en,zh-Hans}/*.ts` (22 terms), `src/pages/[lang]/`.
- Gates: `pnpm content:lint` (resolves every internal link and glossary cross-ref, #137; fails a published locale with no English original, #155), `pnpm check`, `pnpm build` (runs `gen:zh-hant` + published lint), `pnpm seo:smoke` (marketing hreflang + switcher targets, #138; sitemap `lastmod`, #161). **Merging to `main` publishes.**
- Governed here: `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/**` → draft, review-requested to `os-zhuang`, human merge.

## 2. Current PM

**🟢 Occupied** — `session_01FeA1nwBz1ohH65dvffUGKr`, R4 since 2026-09-02 ~07:05Z on 「这些问题你都帮我处理」.

- 「版面不好看的问题肯定要想办法解决啊」 — a visual defect is work, not a note.

- 「然后继续处理后续所有任务」 (2026-08-26) — run the whole queue.
- 「改写 date 往前分散。」 (2026-09-02) — one-time `date` rewrite, §7.
- 「这些问题你都帮我处理」 (2026-09-02) — R4 mandate.
- **「后续并发不要超过5」 (2026-09-02 ~09:30Z)** — at most 5 concurrent agents.
- **「你写的blog注意日期要分散开。，这些都要计入本项目的agents.md」 (2026-09-02 ~09:35Z)** — spread slot dates; the working rules go into `AGENTS.md` → #132 / PR #154, awaiting the human merge.
- 「继续」 (2026-09-02 ~11:20Z, after the wall) — resume.

## 5. Standing commitments

- **Overlap is checked in bodies, not titles.**
- **Re-derive, never translate.** Paid off six times (#60, #62→#103, #63→objectstack#12278, #64→#116, #65, #86).
- **Test viewports must be real viewports.** 1366×625 · 1440×750 · 1512×830 · 1920×945 · 390×844 · 360×800.
- **A blocked download is not proof of absence** (objectstack#12229). Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`; never `playwright install`.
- **Lazy images read as broken at `networkidle`** — scroll into view and `decode()` first.
- **Assertions do not see ugly, do not see dark-on-dark, and do not see lost colour.** Every new or changed SVG is rendered at native size and looked at by the seat. Four traps now measured: a `fill` attribute shadowed by a class (#125/#133); text with neither class nor fill on a dark ground (#140); authored colours silently replaced by the stylesheet default, which is legibility passing while fidelity fails (#156 patch); and the same cascade eating `font-family` (#165). The house `text{…}` type selector defeats **four** different ways of declaring a property — that is the general lesson, not four separate ones.
- **Review against GitHub, not the report — and claim only what you did.** A dead dev's PR is reviewed from its diff and the seat's own build.
- **PM-supplied constants get falsified** — ten cards this tenure (latest: #150's "clipped" tables actually scroll; #78's "46 posts" are 52 with no tag pages at all; #140's "~8 nodes" were 51).
- **Cadence is enforced at the merge, never by rewriting dates.** A refresh sets `updated` and lands when green — it is not a post and consumes no slot (#68/#69/#70/#143/#149/#171). A stand-down order does not override cadence.
- **`date` is publication; rewriting it is a maintainer ruling, never the seat's.**
- **Vendor facts an agent cannot reach get spot-checked from the seat**; runtime facts are grepped in `/home/user/objectstack` at `origin/main`. When the seat cannot settle a date either, the post says less rather than guessing (§7, Databricks).
- **Concurrency is a maintainer-set ceiling, not a seat convenience** (≤ 5); the seat keeps one slot free for patch rounds.
- **Cross-wall discipline:** before a usage wall every dev commits and pushes WIP, the seat flushes state here and arms a post-reset timer; after it, dead devs are resumed in place, never re-implemented.
- **Never `git stash`; per-task worktrees; kill servers by PID after checking `/proc/<pid>/cwd`; three-dot diffs when a branch predates `main`'s movement.**

## 6. Open on the maintainer

- **#154** (`AGENTS.md` working rules) — human merge.
- **Tier-2 vocabulary width (#158):** under the closed tag vocabulary 24 of 52 English posts carry `tags: []`. The seat shipped it as ruled (#77 「同意」); whether tier 2 should grow a bounded set is positioning, so it is the maintainer's call. Seat recommendation: keep the closed list and treat #158 as a content gap, not a tag gap.
- A stray `finding` label a dev minted here (now on zero issues) can be deleted.

## 7. Rulings

- **Tier-1 vocabulary (#77, 2026-08-26, 「同意」):** `open business ontology` · `metadata driven development` (never unqualified; never a tag) · `review AI generated code`.
- **#67 fold** · **#76/#117 sourcing** · **#128 dates** (one-time, by instruction; not a precedent) · **#86 retarget** · **concurrency ≤ 5** — as previously recorded.
- **#134:** the switcher keeps the same page in the chosen locale; `hreflang` lists authored locales only.
- **#130 `updated`:** link-only edits leave it unset; refreshes set it.
- **#79:** gate keys on published locale files; opt-out `noEnglishOriginal: "<why>"`, printed every run; blocking from day one.
- **#132 line budget:** 12 content lines + 2 structural blanks.
- **#78 vocabulary:** closed list = seven tier-2 canonicals per locale + vendors the post compares against; a product a post *runs on* is not one it *compares against* (#163, `Claude Code`); tier-2-table order, then tier-3; empty tags are a measurement (#158).
- **#150:** premise half-falsified — tables already scrolled; the affordance was the defect.
- **#140 (2026-09-03):** the geometry exception was **authorised** for `enterprise-agent-true-cost/cover{,-en}.svg` — merge is publish, so shipping a knowingly garbled asset is not an option the seat takes. Closed #164 in the same PR.
- **#69 / #171 Databricks GA month (2026-09-03):** **no month is attributed to that GA in any post.** The seat searched and could not settle April vs June from a primary source, and vendor pages are unreachable from this container. Both posts now say GA in 2026; the June summit is named only for Business Glossary and Domains, which is well sourced. A month returns only when someone opens the vendor's own announcement.
- **#139:** option 2 — export the topic slugs as data, mirroring `clusters.ts`; the exemption line goes when resolution arrives; the ablation is the deliverable since no body link uses a hub today.
- **#142:** rewrite `/zh-Hans/` → `/zh-Hant/` **conditionally** (only where the Traditional target is built) and on link targets only; hand-written locales are out of scope and got their own card, #179.
- **#166:** taken, not left as a note — keep the hue, change the lightness to the AA floor for the rendered size, smallest step that clears it. `.none` at 1.70:1 reads as a fault, not as de-emphasis.
- **#165:** close the class, do not patch the instance.
- **REST vs MCP in dispatch words (2026-09-03):** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` says REST list endpoints and never MCP `list_issues`. In **this container** REST is unreachable (403 "GitHub access is not enabled for this session", measured on #116), so MCP with minimal fields is the sanctioned fallback for this repo and dispatch words say so explicitly. The #68 dev was right to flag the conflict rather than pick a side silently; recorded here so later dispatches stop tripping on it.
